# Estimating a population network using `phangorn`

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(vcfR)
library(stringr)
library(StAMPP)
library(tidyverse)
library(adegenet)
library(phangorn)

setwd("/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/snp-analyses/neighbor-network")

### Read in linkage-pruned VCFs
vcf <- read.vcfR("/scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss90_LD.vcf")
gen <- vcfR2genlight(vcf)
gen1 <- gen[indNames(gen) != "8304.pietro.aligned.sorted_8304.pietro.aligned.sorted"]

specimens <- str_split(gen1@ind.names, "_", simplify = TRUE)
specimens <- apply(specimens, 1, function(row){
    if(row[1] == row[2]) {
        return(row[1])
    } else {
        return(paste(row[1], row[2], sep = "_"))
    }
})
specimens <- specimens %>% str_replace(".aligned.sorted", "")
gen1@ind.names <- specimens

gen1@pop <- as.factor(gen1@ind.names)

### Estimate Nei's D
neiD <- stamppNeisD(geno = gen1, pop = FALSE)
colnames(neiD) <- rownames(neiD)
isSymmetric(neiD)

nei_dist <- as.dist(neiD)

### Estimate networks
nnet <- neighborNet(nei_dist)
save(nnet, file = "full_miss90_LD_n-net.RData")
```

## Full sampling
```{r, fig.width = 21, fig.height = 21}
library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(phangorn)

library(ggtree)

### load network object into R
load("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/snp-analyses/network/full_miss90_LD_n-net.RData")

### load `popmap` table
samp_df <- read_table("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/sampling-master-detailed.tsv")

### Define color and shape scheme for all taxa

col_labs <- c(

  "brevirostris"     = "A. brevirostris",
  "caudalis"         = "A. caudalis",

  "dom4"             = "A. d. dominicensis (west)",
  "favillarum"       = "A. d. favillarum",
  "east_ignigularis" = "A. d. ignigularis (east)",
  "west_ignigularis" = "A. d. ignigularis (west)",
  "marron"           = "A. marron",
  "ocior"            = "A. d. ocior",
  "properus"         = "A. d. properus",
  "ravitergum"       = "A. d. ravitergum",
  "sejunctus"        = "A. d. sejunctus",
  "suppar"           = "A. d. suppar",
  "vinosus"          = "A. d. vinosus",
  "websteri"         = "A. websteri"
)

shp_labs = c(
    "aurifer"          = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "biminiensis"      = "Bahamian A. distichus subspecies",
    "brevirostris"     = "A. brevirostris species group",
    "caudalis"         = "A. brevirostris species group",
    "dapsilis"         = "Bahamian A. distichus subspecies",
    "distichoides"     = "Bahamian A. distichus subspecies",
    "distichus"        = "Bahamian A. distichus subspecies",
    "dom1"             = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "dom2"             = "Eastern A. distichus subspecies",
    "dom3"             = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "dom4"             = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "favillarum"       = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "east_ignigularis" = "Eastern A. distichus subspecies",
    "west_ignigularis" = "Eastern A. distichus subspecies",
    "marron"           = "A. brevirostris species group",
    "ocior"            = "Bahamian A. distichus subspecies",
    "properus"         = "Eastern A. distichus subspecies",
    "ravitergum"       = "Eastern A. distichus subspecies",
    "sejunctus"        = "Eastern A. distichus subspecies",
    "suppar"           = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "vinosus"          = "Western A. distichus subspecies",
    "websteri"         = "A. brevirostris species group" 
)

samp_df$clade <- shp_labs[samp_df$population_post]
shps <- c(
    "Western A. distichus subspecies"  = 22,
    "Bahamian A. distichus subspecies" = 23,
    "Eastern A. distichus subspecies"  = 21,
    "A. brevirostris species group"    = 24
)

samp_df <- samp_df %>% arrange(factor(specimen, levels = nnet$tip.label))
nnet$tip.label = paste(nnet$tip.label, samp_df$population_post, sep = "_")
samp_df <- samp_df %>% mutate(cols = cols[population_post]) %>%
    mutate(shapes = shps[clade])
tip_df <- data.frame(label = nnet$tip.label, color_code = samp_df$cols, shp_code = samp_df$shapes)
plot(nnet)

net_plt <- ggsplitnet(nnet)  %<+% tip_df +
    # geom_tiplab2(hjust = -0.1) + 
    geom_tippoint(aes(fill = color_code, shape = shp_code), size = 6, color = "white") + 
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_shape_identity() +
    hexpand(0.3) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))
net_plt

ggsave("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/figures/neighbor-network-full-sampling-nolab.pdf", plot = net_plt, width = 20, height = 24, dpi = 350) 
```
